theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Building Your Financial Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months of expenses. It protects you from unexpected financial shocks and reduces stress.
caption: Before investing or spending, set aside money for emergencies. This foundation helps you handle life's surprises without derailing your goals. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #MoneyManagement #FinancialWellness #SmartMoney
